# Lumina

> Lumina is an AI meeting assistant for teams. It joins Zoom, Google Meet, and
> Microsoft Teams calls, records and transcribes them, and turns every meeting into a
> summary with decisions and action items.

Lumina was formerly known as InboxZap, an email-cleanup tool. The product was rebuilt
around meetings; InboxZap no longer exists as a separate product.

## Pages

- [Home](https://lumina.example/): Overview, how it works, FAQ.
- [Features](https://lumina.example/features): Recording, transcription, AI summaries, integrations.
- [Pricing](https://lumina.example/pricing): Free, Pro ($12/seat/month), and Enterprise plans.
- [Blog](https://lumina.example/blog): Articles on meetings, productivity, and teamwork.
